mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a single month signals strong economic growth, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 300k and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < -0.5% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM > 1% and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points month-over-month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE MoM > 0.5pp and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 5% and RSAFS MoM < -1% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the tight labor market and high interest rates create a drag on economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with low unemployment
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 4% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
